spontaneous_coronary_artery_dissection.recommendation: In patients with spontaneous coronary artery dissection, PCI is recommended only for patients with symptoms and signs of ongoing myocardial ischaemia, a large area of myocardium in jeopardy, and reduced antegrade flow.

thrombus_aspiration.recommendation: The routine use of thrombus aspiration is not recommended.

multivessel_disease_recommendations.header: Recommendations for management of patients with multivessel disease
multivessel_disease_recommendations.recommendation: It is recommended to base the revascularization strategy (IRA PCI, multivessel PCI/CABG) on the patient's clinical status and comorbidities, as well as their disease complexity, according to the principles of management of myocardial revascularization.
